4377-4423-6886-8344.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4377-4423-6886-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
4377-4423-6886-8344.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

1849-5078-6766-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6073--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

728-2158-3249-5553.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5879-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Walking Archive.
When Walking Archive dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

261-1981-2034-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
261-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

2869-3184-6797--44.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact with a mana cost of {0}.
Yomiji triggers, returning the artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and animating it until end of turn.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Repeat.

330-2474-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.
330-2474-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 3 damage to Smaug due to City on Fire.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4559-5147-6291-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
4559-5147-6291-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2034-2267-3240-6462.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-955-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-955-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.
339-677-955-6974.notes: You can create infinite Treasures using Ashling's Command, and then use those Treasures to create tokens of Maelstrom Wanderer instead of Jegantha. This allows you to get infinite cascade triggers with mana value 7 or less.

296-2604-3532-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-2604-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3129-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2301-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it

656-3394-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Weatherlight Compleated.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, causing you to put a phyresis counter on it and draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-4321.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token and a Food token.
Activate the Insect and Food by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3055-6553-6798.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
3055-6553-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4484-4871-6518-6798.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-6518-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

280-1825-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Golgari Rot Farm and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
280-1825-6760.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Golgari Rot Farm and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

2457-4094-4289-4927.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-4289-4927.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2122-3921-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-3921-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3139-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
3139-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

413-3817-5170.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
413-3817-5170.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield, and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Junji enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-2523-5563.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Uruk-hai Berserker, adding {C}{C}.
When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5147-5434-5541-5555.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5147-5434-5541-5555.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

101-1987-2103-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
101-1987-2103-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

1228-5256-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-5256-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 2.

2211-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2211-2257-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Captain's Hook, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

1183-4853-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-4853-5116.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

2988-3231-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2988-3231-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, targeting yourself and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity and Dictate of the Twin Gods.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing 100 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3.

1018-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Skullwinder
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Skullwinder
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

654-2203-2692-2893.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2203-2692-2893.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Felidar Retreat triggers.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Tap the land for {G}{G}.
Repeat.

751-1479-2719.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of Kodama of the East Tree.
751-1479-2719.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake.
When Shrieking Drake ETBs, Shrieking Drake, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, not putting anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, put Shrieking Drake from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Shrieking Drake ETBs, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Shrieking Drake trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, putting Shrieking Drake from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Shrieking Drake ETBs, Kodama of the East Tree and Shrieking Drake trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Shrieking Drake from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 6.

387-945-4050.description:
Cast Relentless Dead.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating two 1/1 Thrull tokens.
Sacrifice Relentless Dead and 2 Thrull tokens for {B}{B}{B}.
Relentless Dead triggers, pay {B} to return it to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2820-5237.description:
Sacrifice Renegade Rallier to Ashnod's Altar, generating {C}{C}.
Sacrifice Angelic Renewal to return Renegade Rallier to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier triggers, returning Angelic Renewal to the battlefield.
